abilities.name: Strength
abilities.description: Strength measures bodily power, athletic training, and the extent to which you can exert raw physical force.

abilities.name: Dexterity
abilities.description: Dexterity measures agility, reflexes, and balance.

abilities.name: Constitution
abilities.description: Constitution measures health, stamina, and vital force.

abilities.name: Intelligence
abilities.description: Intelligence measures mental acuity, accuracy of recall, and the ability to reason.

abilities.name: Wisdom
abilities.description: Wisdom reflects how attuned you are to the world around you and represents perceptiveness and intuition.

abilities.name: Charisma
abilities.description: Charisma measures your ability to interact effectively with others, including confidence and eloquence.

skills.name: Acrobatics
skills.description: Your Dexterity (Acrobatics) check covers your attempt to stay on your feet in a tricky situation, such as trying to run across a sheet of ice, balance on a tightrope, or stay upright on a rocking ship deck.

skills.name: Animal Handling
skills.description: When there is any question whether you can calm down a domesticated animal, keep a mount from getting spooked, or intuit an animal’s intentions, call for a Wisdom (Animal Handling) check.

skills.name: Arcana
skills.description: Your Intelligence (Arcana) check measures your ability to recall lore about spells, magic items, eldritch symbols, magical traditions, the planes of existence, and the inhabitants of those planes.

skills.name: Athletics
skills.description: Your Strength (Athletics) check covers difficult situations you encounter while climbing, jumping, or swimming, as well as grappling and shoving.

skills.name: Deception
skills.description: Your Charisma (Deception) check determines whether you can convincingly hide the truth, either verbally or through your actions.

skills.name: History
skills.description: Your Intelligence (History) check measures your ability to recall lore about historical events, legendary people, ancient kingdoms, past disputes, recent wars, and lost civilizations.

skills.name: Insight
skills.description: Your Wisdom (Insight) check decides whether you can determine the true intentions of a creature, such as when searching out a lie or predicting someone’s next move.

skills.name: Intimidation
skills.description: When you attempt to influence someone through overt threats, hostile actions, and physical violence, make a Charisma (Intimidation) check.

skills.name: Investigation
skills.description: When you look around for clues and make deductions based on those clues, you make an Intelligence (Investigation) check.

skills.name: Medicine
skills.description: A Wisdom (Medicine) check lets you try to stabilize a dying companion or diagnose an illness.

skills.name: Nature
skills.description: Your Intelligence (Nature) check measures your ability to recall lore about terrain, plants and animals, the weather, and natural cycles.

skills.name: Perception
skills.description: Your Wisdom (Perception) check lets you spot, hear, or otherwise detect the presence of something.

skills.name: Performance
skills.description: Your Charisma (Performance) check determines how well you can delight an audience with music, dance, acting, storytelling, or some other form of entertainment.

skills.name: Persuasion
skills.description: When you attempt to influence someone or a group of people with tact, social graces, or good nature, make a Charisma (Persuasion) check.

skills.name: Religion
skills.description: Your Intelligence (Religion) check measures your ability to recall lore about deities, rites and prayers, religious hierarchies, holy symbols, and the practices of secret cults.

skills.name: Sleight of Hand
skills.description: Whenever you attempt an act of legerdemain or manual trickery, such as planting something on someone else or concealing an object on your person, make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check.

skills.name: Stealth
skills.description: Make a Dexterity (Stealth) check when you attempt to conceal yourself from enemies, slink past guards, slip away without being noticed, or sneak up on someone without being seen or heard.

skills.name: Survival
skills.description: A Wisdom (Survival) check is made to follow tracks, hunt wild game, guide your group through frozen wastelands, identify signs that owlbears live nearby, predict the weather, or avoid quicksand and other natural hazards.
